recipes.name: Gajar Halwa
steps: Wash, peel and grate the carrots.
Cook the grated carrot in the milk in a heavy pan on medium heat, stirring often, until nearly all the milk has dried up (35 to 40 minutes).
Add ghee and sugar and keep stirring; the mixture loosens at first, then thickens again as the sugar cooks down.
Stir in crumbled khoya if using, crushed cardamom, chopped nuts and raisins.
Serve warm; it keeps in the fridge for 3 to 4 days.

recipes.name: Rice Kheer
steps: Wash the rice and soak it for 20 minutes, then drain.
Bring the milk to a boil in a heavy-bottomed pan, add the rice and simmer on low heat, stirring and scraping the bottom often.
Cook for 35 to 40 minutes until the rice is very soft and the milk has thickened and reduced.
Add sugar, crushed cardamom, saffron and chopped nuts, and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Serve warm or chilled; it thickens further as it cools.

recipes.name: Sooji Halwa
steps: Warm about 1 1/2 cups of water with the sugar until it dissolves, and keep it hot.
In a heavy pan melt the ghee and roast the sooji on low heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown and fragrant (8 to 10 minutes).
Carefully pour the hot sugar water into the sooji while stirring, as it will splutter.
Keep stirring until the halwa thickens and leaves the sides of the pan, then add crushed cardamom, cashews and raisins.
Serve warm as a quick sweet or prasad.
